label: Post-infectious Guillain-Barré syndrome during a cholera outbreak in Yemen: A pediatric case with confirmed Campylobacter exposure.
summary: Yemen's prolonged conflict and fragile healthcare infrastructure have created a setting where infectious diseases like cholera frequently overlap with under-recognized post-infectious autoimmune conditions. In this context, we report a pediatric case of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) following recent Campylobacter jejuni infection during a laboratory-confirmed cholera outbreak in rural Southern Yemen.
